{{Quote|You're a Clawdite, too.''"<br />"''That doesn't make us sisters.|Holowan's Clawdite decoy learns Wesell's true identity|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes">''[[Star Wars Adventures 5: The Shape-Shifter Strikes]]''</ref>}}
During the years of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Hurlo Holowan]] hired a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] to act as a '''decoy''' should [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] attempt to capture or kill the woman. This being was a [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifter]] who mimicked the appearance of Holowan.

When fellow Clawdite and bounty hunter [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] came searching for Holowan, she attacked the decoy instead. The decoy tried to flee but was stunned and fell to the ground. After the decoy divulged Holowan's true location, Wesell stunned the decoy again and stashed the unconscious being in a closet in [[House of Holowan|Holowan's mansion]] on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Clawdite is referred to with the pronoun "she" in the text, there is nothing that outright states the being's gender. As Zam Wesell illustrates throughout that novel, it is possible for a Clawdite to mimic other genders. Therefore, any guess to the decoy's true gender is speculation.
